articles.title: 22k gold rate today: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (June 9, 2026) at Tanishq, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers, Malabar Gold & Diamonds and IBJA
articles.summary: Gold prices experienced an increase today across major Indian jewellery brands and the India Bullion and Jewellers Association (IBJA). This surge is reportedly influenced by investors seeking more cues regarding geopolitical developments, likely concerning Israel. This trend highlights the sensitivity of India's commodity markets to international events, impacting investment decisions and consumer purchasing power within the country.

articles.title: 850 acres of vacant defence land in UP to host 250 MW solar power plant
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has approved a 250 MW solar power project in Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh. This significant initiative utilizes approximately 850 acres of vacant defence land, demonstrating the Ministry's commitment to renewable energy and sustainable development. It effectively repurposes idle defence assets for national energy security and green initiatives, contributing to India's clean energy goals.

articles.title: Daniel Ellsberg vs. “Ordinary Insanity”
articles.summary: A new documentary delivers an urgent warning about 'dangerous nuclear delusions,' prompting a critical re-evaluation of global nuclear policies. It references historical events like the 'Small Boy' nuclear test, part of Operation Sunbeam, which involved soldiers and cameramen. The film aims to highlight the enduring risks of nuclear weapons and challenge assumptions about their role in international security.

articles.title: 'Should UPSC be conducted by Isro?' Shekhar Suman's satire on NEET paper airlift plan; watch
articles.summary: Actor Shekhar Suman satirically questioned whether the UPSC should be conducted by ISRO, reacting to the NEET exam paper "airlift plan." His comments highlight ongoing concerns and public scrutiny regarding the conduct and security of national competitive examinations like NEET, suggesting a need for robust administrative mechanisms, similar to ISRO's precision.

articles.title: Defence Ministry clears 250 MW solar project with battery storage in Uttar Pradesh's Sitapur
articles.summary: The Defence Ministry has approved a 250 MW solar power project, integrated with a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), on vacant defence land in Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh. This strategic initiative aims to enhance renewable energy utilization within the defence sector, ensuring energy security and contributing to India's green energy goals by leveraging existing land assets for sustainable power generation.

articles.title: Cast your vote for the Oshkosh and Fond du Lac Athlete of the Week
articles.summary: The Oshkosh and Fond du Lac Athlete of the Week poll is currently open, inviting the public to vote for top local athletes from June 1-7. This initiative spotlights regional sporting talent across various disciplines, including baseball and girls' sports. Aspirants should note such local engagement, reflecting community spirit and recognition of athletic achievement within specific national regions, with voting concluding on June 12.

articles.title: Judge Upholds Nonhuman Voting in Delaware Beach Town, Dismisses ACLU Challenge
articles.summary: A Delaware Superior Court judge dismissed an ACLU lawsuit seeking to prevent nonhuman entities, such as corporations or trusts, from voting in Fenwick Island town elections. The ruling upholds the existing policy, where property-owning entities can cast votes, often via representatives. This decision sparks debate on voting rights and corporate influence in local governance, offering insights into democratic frameworks.
